title: Canonical whole-system point transport and normalized realization comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], $\ell\ne D.p$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $s=\operatorname{Spec}D.k$, $h$ for its geometric Frobenius and $h^r$ for every $r\ge0$, using [def-trf-point-power-restriction-data]. Use the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], whole semilinear quotient systems, restriction $U$, realization $\mathcal L=R\lim U$, and exact system pullback $G_r$ of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Define $\Gamma_\bullet=\Gamma_R\circ U$ by the exact module-tower sections and their fixed lifted coefficient presentation [def-trf-coefficient-tower-operations], [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors]. Define $I_{r,C}:\Gamma_\bullet C\to\Gamma_\bullet G_r C$ by localization of restriction along $h^r$, insertion into the inverse-image colimit, sheafification and the adjunction unit $x\mapsto x\otimes1$, on complexes of whole systems with their actual quotient transitions, before individual evaluation. The ordinary transformation is the unique one with this formula on every section. Use the constant-tower/total-limit adjunction and its whole counit of [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models] and [def-trf-coefficient-tower-operations]. Define $a_r:(h^r)^{-1}\mathcal L C\simeq\mathcal L G_r C$ as the unique adjunction mate of inverse image applied to this whole counit, with the tensor-unit restriction comparison; define $\zeta_C:R\lim\Gamma_\bullet C\simeq\Gamma_R(\mathcal L C)$ as the inverse of the analogously counit-normalized sections/limit mate. These specify the comparisons on whole towers, rather than their individual evaluations. For $N=\mathcal L C$ derived-complete bounded constructible [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], define $\nu_{r,C}=a_r\kappa_N^{-1}:L(h^r)^*N\simeq\mathcal L G_r C$, using the actual integral comparison $\kappa$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and its canonical inverse on that domain. Finally define integral $\iota^{(r)}_N=\Gamma_R(\kappa_N)\sigma_{r,N}$ by the restriction chain map and localization comparisons, as in [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport] for $h^r$. No power, naturality or realization equation is asserted by this definition.
